messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Chris Turner <chris@rivetcloud.com>
Cc: rivet-partner-success@rivetcloud.com
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch ramp contingency playbook and docs blackline

Team / Chris —

We have the tentative ramp window for RivetCloud on Oct 6. Before we lock, we need to confirm three things this week so we can finalize the public-facing enablement and the internal rollback playbook: 

1) Final rollback window and expected traffic profile (ops/infra)
2) Docs owners to publish the enablement quickstart and runbook (docs + CS)
3) SLA exception signoff for a temporary latency target during week-of ramp (product/security)

I've attached the current launch_ramp_tracker.csv with suggested owners and a minimal timeline. Chris, could you confirm whether Rivet can tolerate the October 6 ramp with a 10–15% request error tolerance in the first 48 hours? If not, tell us your preferred stagger and we will adapt.

Proposed plan:
- Oct 6: Canary to 5% of traffic (region US-WEST)
- Oct 7–8: Monitor, enable cache warmup, increase to 25% if telemetry is green
- Oct 10: Full roll at 100% if no regressions

Please reply with owners and any hard constraints by EOD Friday. If we don't have signoff, we will push the start date by a week and publish a revised enablement deck.

Thanks —
Soojin
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: launch_ramp_tracker.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Chris Turner <chris@rivetcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00

On Thu, Sep 18, 2025 at 09:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Chris —
> 
> We have the tentative ramp window for RivetCloud on Oct 6. Before we lock, we need to confirm three things this week so we can finalize the public-facing enablement and the internal rollback playbook:
> 

Thanks Soojin — quick notes from enablement/docs POV: 

- Ownership: I will own the external enablement deck and the quickstart. Aditya will do the internal runbooks with eng on-level run commands and rollback steps.
- Delivery: I can have the draft enablement deck and quickstart published to the drive link by Tue 23 Sep. I will need the final runbook (Aditya) by Mon 22 Sep to incorporate commands and escalation paths.
- Training: Recommend two 30-minute office hours the week before ramp (Oct 1 and Oct 3) for Rivet engineers + internal support.

Attachment: enablement_outline.pdf — includes slide skeleton and proposed quickstart flow.

Open Q: Do we have a concrete fallback model variant to recommend if we need to trade latency for cost/throughput? Product team, can you confirm the preferred fallback (quantized smaller model vs higher-cost large model)?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Developer Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Chris Turner <chris@rivetcloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: rivet-partner-success@rivetcloud.com
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch ramp contingency playbook and docs blackline

Thanks Soojin / Marissa —

We can do Oct 6 as long as the canary is limited to US-WEST and we have a clear rollback that limits impact to <5% of customer sessions. We cannot accept a 10–15% error tolerance during a business-critical window; that will fail our SLAs internally.

A couple of asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm the planned cache-warmup strategy and whether KV prefix caching will be enabled for our traffic pattern?
- Please share the runbook that your on-call will use for a cross-team rollback (we'll mirror it on our side).

We can attend the Oct 1 office hours.

—Chris Turner
Director, Platform Engineering
RivetCloud
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Chris Turner <chris@rivetcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch ramp contingency playbook and docs blackline

Soojin —

We can't sign off on the proposed timetable with a 10–15% error tolerance either. Per security/compliance and our SLA params, I am drafting an exception request for a temporary latency target bump (SLA_exception_request.pdf) but we need to keep error budget under 3% during the canary. If Rivet cannot accept the 3% threshold, we should do a staged ramp by customer cohort instead of global % traffic.

Operational notes: 
- Engineering will enable KV prefix cache and a short TTL warmup for canary traffic.
- We'll pre-provision an extra GPU pool in US-WEST for the first 48 hours (Aditya to confirm).
- If error rate exceeds 3% for two consecutive 5-minute windows, automated rollback to previous model variant will trigger and ops will page the on-call list.

(Quoted for context)
> From: Chris Turner <chris@rivetcloud.com>
> We can do Oct 6 as long as the canary is limited to US-WEST and we have a clear rollback...

Vivek
VP, Product & Trust
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Chris Turner <chris@rivetcloud.com>
Cc: rivet-partner-success@rivetcloud.com
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch ramp contingency playbook and docs blackline

Team — thanks for the quick turns. Summary / decisions: 

- Owners: Marissa (external enablement + office hours), Aditya (internal runbooks + pre-provision confirmation), Vivek (SLA exception coordination + exception doc owner).
- Canary: Oct 6 limited to US-WEST, 2% initial traffic (reduced from 5%) with staged increases (2% -> 10% -> 25%) only if error budget < 1.5% for two consecutive 10-minute windows.
- SLA: Vivek will file the formal SLA_exception_request and route to Legal for signoff; temporary latency bump allowed only with executive approval.
- Docs: Marissa will publish the external quickstart by Tue 23 Sep; Aditya to deliver internal runbook by Mon 22 Sep.
- Ops: KV prefix cache enabled for canary; Aditya please confirm GPU pool provisioning by Monday.

Next steps: 
- Vivek to share SLA_exception_request.pdf and HubSpot note (HS-98342) when ready.
- Marissa to post enablement slide draft to the drive link.
- Aditya to confirm provisioning and paste runbook link into the tracker.

If no objections, I will mark the tracker as "Ready for launch" on Monday 22 Sep and schedule the office hours.

—Soojin
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
